Heavy-Duty Utility Performance

Built for Agriculture. Engineered for Long Workdays.

The RX6620PCB combines high horsepower, strong hydraulic performance, and premium operator comfort into a versatile utility tractor platform. Designed for loader work, hay handling, brush cutting, tillage, grading, and farm operations, it delivers dependable power and stability for demanding workloads.

Features May Include:

66 HP Turbo Diesel Engine

Turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine delivers strong torque, fuel efficiency, and dependable performance for demanding agricultural applications.

Fully Enclosed Climate-Controlled Cab

Factory-installed cab with heating and air conditioning improves comfort during long workdays and harsh weather conditions.

Power Shuttle Transmission

12×12 power shuttle transmission allows smooth directional changes and improved loader productivity without clutching.

Four-Wheel Drive (4WD)

MFWD system improves traction, pulling power, and stability across rough terrain and muddy field conditions.

Heavy Hydraulic Capability

Open-center hydraulic system delivers strong lift performance and supports loader and rear implement operation.

Independent PTO System

Independent rear PTO supports rotary cutters, tillers, hay equipment, spreaders, and additional implements.

Category II Three-Point Hitch

Heavy-duty rear hitch supports larger agricultural implements and increased lifting capacity.

Deluxe Suspension Seat

Premium adjustable suspension seat reduces fatigue and improves comfort during extended operation.

Hydrostatic Power Steering

Responsive steering system improves maneuverability and operator control.

Loader Compatibility

Compatible with KIOTI front-end loaders for material handling, dirt work, feed movement, and pallet applications.
